sentences: Patient is a 31-year-old woman with low back pain for about four months.
No fever, weight loss, saddle numbness or cancer history.
Symptoms persist after more than two months of physical therapy and daily naproxen.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.

payer_letter: Bluepeak Insurance has reviewed claim A-1012 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of at least six weeks of conservative treatment together with radicular findings or an objective neurological deficit, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document radicular symptoms or a neurological deficit. You may request reconsideration within 90 days of this notice.
